models: Tüm VAG Grubu Modeller (Audi, VW, Seat, Skoda, Porsche)
engines: Tüm VAG Benzinli (TSI/TFSI) ve Dizel (TDI) Motorlar
commonCauses: Kablo Tesisatı ve Soketleri and/or Connector(s) from/to Brake Electronics Control Module (J104) faulty
stepByStepSolution: Kontrol edin:  Sigorta ve Röle Bağlantıları(s)
Kontrol edin:  Kablo Tesisatı ve Soketleri and/or Connector(s) from/to Brake Electronics Control Module (J104)
Kontrol edin: /Değiştirin / Yenileyin:  Brake Electronics Control Module (J104)
technicalNotes:
This Fault Code usually effects the Hydraulic Unit (N55) and the Hydraulic Pump (V39).
On vehicles that use the Bosch ABS system this connection is typically a separate 2 wire connector below the module. When this fault is stored after module replacement make sure it was reconnected.
